# AI Marketing Governance

`ai-marketing-governance` · v1.0.1 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/ai-marketing-governance/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is our team ready to publish AI-drafted marketing work, and does each citation in a draft meet the rules before it ships?

**Inputs:** Which AI tools the team uses and for what, whether the plan trains on inputs, who reviews before publish, and the claims and citations in a draft

**Output:** A readiness score with the gaps named, a filled-in policy with owners and a review date, a per-citation verdict, and the five rules as a card the team can pin up

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill ai-marketing-governance`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/ai-marketing-governance/resources/ai-governance.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/ai-marketing-governance/resources/ai-governance.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It is a rule check, not a fact checker. A citeable verdict means the citation has the right parts; it cannot tell whether the study exists. It does not replace legal or compliance review.
- The draft sweep only spots figures written with %, "percent", "x" or $. Plain counts such as "110 startups" go unflagged, so read the draft for every number.
- Readiness credits tools only against the engine's six task labels, matched exactly, and scores what you say was verified. It cannot see your plan's real training setting.
- Give {check, input}; with no input you get a labelled demo. An unknown check or top-level field stops the run, but fields inside input that it doesn't know are ignored, so use the names in the header.

**Review before acting:** The named reviewer opens every cited document before publish, and the policy owner checks the training-on-inputs setting on the plan itself. Legal or compliance reviews disclosure, data and claims rules for your markets.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/ai-marketing-governance](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/ai-marketing-governance)
